behavior_change_rationale.1: The case now supplies status/rename-branch.md and status/rename.diff showing the rename and its coupled semantic tweak as state already committed on the current branch, not a proposal for a future/not-yet-started feature, so the agent evaluates real evidence instead of an abstract description.
behavior_change_rationale.2: No repository diff or file state is provided for this case by design; the prompt now says so explicitly so the agent evaluates strictly from the stated description instead of assuming files or a diff that do not exist, which would create an inconsistent grading premise.
behavior_change_rationale.4: Tests and directly coupled docs stay with the behavior they verify. Real implementation, test, doc and diff/status fixtures support the atomicity assessment. The atomic-success rubric requires proportionate validation, not an added acceptance-criteria block: acceptance criteria belong to proposed split units under the skill's output contract. This corrects a corpus mismatch without enlarging atomic-success output or regrading frozen observations.
behavior_change_rationale.5: Splits are organized by logical purpose instead of artifact type.
behavior_change_rationale.6: Supplies the existing mixed-change facts and three-unit proposal that finalization requires. Recorded cache, logging and display semantics, disjoint paths and existing check commands support concrete acceptance and recovery boundaries without claiming absent code inspection or test results. The five existing finalization expectations remain unchanged.
